around.headline: Dog lick causes fatal rabies case; experts warn of risks
around.summary: The Times of India reports a fatal rabies case after a dog lick, with experts warning about the risk. A lick on a scratch or cut counts as an exposure: wash it well and see a doctor about anti-rabies shots the same day.

around.headline: Suspected gas leak triggers fire in Bengaluru, family of six injured
around.summary: New Indian Express and Deccan Herald report a suspected gas leak led to a fire that injured six members of a family, including four children, per Pioneer Daily. If you smell gas, avoid switches and flames, open windows, close the regulator and step outside.

around.headline: Bengaluru family loses Rs 22 lakh to fake PU board official
around.summary: The Times of India reports the family was cheated by someone posing as a PU board official. Boards don't take money to alter marks or secure seats, so verify any such claim directly with the board or school.

around.headline: Rusted streetlight pole falls, kills man in Bengaluru
around.summary: The Times of India reports a man died when a rusted streetlight pole fell. Avoid standing or parking under visibly corroded poles and report them to BBMP with a photo and location.

around.headline: Woman's 19-km commute takes 3 hours; Bengaluru traffic violations hit a five-year high
around.summary: NDTV and the Times of India carry a commuter's 19 km, 3-hour peak-hour rain ordeal, while Deccan Herald reports traffic violations at a five-year high in 8 months. Leave early on wet days and keep your documents and helmet in order.

around.headline: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper to start this month
around.summary: The Hindu and NDTV report India's second Vande Bharat Sleeper will connect Bengaluru and Mumbai. Wait for the official timetable and fares before booking.

around.headline: "Service charge is voluntary, cannot be forced": Bengaluru Consumer Commission
around.summary: Live Law reports the Bengaluru consumer commission held against a pub that levied service charge. If a bill adds it automatically, you can politely ask for it to be removed.

street_smart.title: A stray dog you were feeding licks a fresh scratch on your hand. The dog looks healthy and friendly, and the scratch barely stings. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Times of India, Oct 4: Dog lick causes fatal rabies case; experts warn of risks.
street_smart.situation: You're on an evening walk and a stray you often pet licks a small cut on your hand. There is no bleeding and no one else is around.

choices.text: Wash the spot with soap and running water for 15 minutes, then go to a hospital today to start anti-rabies vaccination.
choices.feedback: Rabies virus lives in saliva and can enter through broken skin. Long washing flushes much of it out, and the vaccine (plus immunoglobulin for deep or bleeding wounds, as the doctor decides) works only if started early, before symptoms appear.

choices.text: Do nothing. It was just a lick and the dog looks healthy.
choices.feedback: A dog can shed the virus before it looks sick, and once rabies symptoms begin it is almost always fatal. 'Mild' exposures feel harmless, which is exactly why people skip treatment.

choices.text: Wait ten days to see whether the dog falls sick before deciding.
choices.feedback: Observing the animal is useful, but only alongside treatment you've already started. Waiting alone burns the time window in which the vaccine protects you.

choices.text: Rub on turmeric or chilli paste and tie the cut tightly.
choices.feedback: Home remedies don't kill the virus and a tight bandage can trap it. Plain soap and running water is the proven first aid.

takeaways: Wash any bite, scratch or lick on broken skin with soap and running water for 15 minutes, then see a doctor the same day.
Don't wait for the dog to show symptoms; start the anti-rabies course first and let the doctor decide on immunoglobulin.
Dog and cat bites need the full vaccine schedule, so note the dose dates and finish the course.

quiz.question: For how many days will the Bengaluru Jatre run in December?
quiz.why: It runs from December 4 to 13 across streets and parks, with art, culture and community events.

quiz.question: According to the Bengaluru Consumer Commission's observation reported by Live Law, service charge at restaurants and pubs is:
quiz.why: Consumer commissions can order refunds for unfair charges, and you can raise complaints on the national consumer helpline 1915.

quiz.question: How much has drought-hit Karnataka sought from the Centre, according to the Times of India?
quiz.why: This is a request to the Centre, not an approved grant, and the final amount depends on central assessment.

quiz.question: LPG is mainly a mixture of which two gases?
quiz.why: LPG is naturally odourless, so ethyl mercaptan is added to give it the rotten-egg smell that helps you detect leaks.

quiz.question: Which constitutional body conducts elections to Parliament and state legislatures in India?
quiz.why: It is established under Article 324 of the Constitution, and its roll revisions like SIR are why checking your name on the voter list matters.
